findings.description: Product list prices are random: they change on every page load and every time a sort order is chosen, so sorting by price does not order the list, and the list prices never match the detail page, cart or checkout (e.g. Backpack shows $32.78, $73.15, $57.42... but is $29.99 on the detail page and in the cart).
repro: Reload the page or pick Price (low to high) - prices change and are not in ascending order
Open the Backpack detail page: price is $29.99

findings.description: The Sauce Labs Backpack shows a photo of a dog with a tennis ball instead of the backpack (image file sl-404); the detail page shows the correct backpack photo.
repro: Look at the first product card on /inventory.html

findings.description: Names of Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt and Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket are right-aligned (text-align right) while the other product names are left-aligned, so the cards look inconsistent.
repro: Compare title alignment of the product cards on /inventory.html

findings.description: On the Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red) card the Add to cart button sticks out past the right edge of the card (card ends at x=1170, button at 1189), unlike the other cards; at 390px width it overflows the viewport.
repro: Look at the last product card on /inventory.html at 1280px width

findings.description: The Checkout button is rendered at the very top-right of the page, overlapping the header area, instead of sitting with the cart footer actions next to Continue Shopping.
repro: Open /cart.html and look at the position of Checkout

notes: Tested all journeys over Playwright. Checkout totals (8% tax), error messages, logout redirect, sort of names, add/remove and badge counts behaved correctly. The cart icon sits mid-header rather than at the far right on all pages; not reported as it may be baseline design.

cost.notes: estimate from 98644 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0197-$0.2367
